messages:
Priya Rao: Hi all — planning an enablement office-hour rotation for the next 6 weeks. Goal: 2x 1-hour drop-in sessions per week (EMEA-friendly + APAC-friendly) and a single weekly deep-dive for onboarding accounts. Need volunteers for coverage and a quick runbook.
Maya Chen: I can take the EMEA-friendly slot on Tuesdays 10:00–11:00 CET. Prefer recurring invite. :calendar:
Sam Ortiz: Happy to lead the deep-dive on Thursdays, 16:00 PT. Can cover May 6 and 13.
Lin Park: I can cover APAC on Wednesdays 09:00 SGT for the first three weeks, then swap with Maya if needed.
Priya Rao: Awesome, @Maya @Lin @Sam — thanks. Quick poll: prefer a fixed weekly agenda or flexible per-customer? Two options: A) fixed agenda (intros, demo, Q&A, triage) B) flexible (customer-driven each week). Reply with `A` or `B`.
Maya Chen: A
Sam Ortiz: B (leaning flexible for deep-dive)
Lin Park: A for the drop-ins, B for the deep-dive session. Hybrid works for me.
Priya Rao: Cool — we'll do hybrid: fixed agenda for drop-ins, flexible for deep-dive. I'm drafting a one-pager and a short runbook for session leads. Anyone have a concise triage checklist we should include?
Maya Chen: Add: "Confirm customer environment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)" and "Collect 1-2 example prompts or failing flows".
Sam Ortiz: Add: "Rollout/renewal signal? note next renewal date if mentioned" — helps CS prioritization.
Lin Park: Also: quick template to capture actions in the thread and assign owners. 2-line next steps.
Priya Rao: Great notes. Draft runbook snippet (will paste to docs):
```
Session runbook v1:
- 5m: quick intros + account context
- 25m: demo / walkthrough
- 20m: live troubleshooting + triage
- 10m: summary + owner assignment
Artifacts: session notes doc, issues logged to Jira, follow-up email template
```
Priya Rao: I'll create a shared calendar and a short RSVP form (1 min). @SupportBot can you auto-create the calendar slots for the next 6 weeks (Tues/EMEA, Wed/APAC, Thu/deep-dive) and post the invite links here? :pray:
SupportBot: Calendar created: "Enablement Drop-ins (Jun-Jul)". Recurring invites sent to volunteers; public RSVP form: https://forms.redwood.example/enablement-rsvp. Next steps: please confirm your recurring event attendees.
Maya Chen: Confirmed — I accepted the recurring invite.
Sam Ortiz: Accepted. I'll bring the deep-dive deck — 15 slides max.
Lin Park: Accepted. I'll prepare an APAC-friendly primer for timezone attendees.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. I'll add the runbook to the internal CS playbook and drop the link here once posted. Quick follow-up: please reply with any blockers by EOD so we can triage before next week. :white_check_mark:
